title: New Inventory Part lists its fields in the set order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Scroll the window from top to bottom.
  3. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Inventory Part" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Cost, Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (the bin row, then "Add Bin Location").
  • There is no Part Status, and the cost field reads "Cost", not "Average Cost".

Step 3:

  • The window closes and no part is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.1 New Inventory Part opens". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-01-p1-1-new-empty.png

The design's own words:

  • “Description first, then Part Number. Both are free text (S7-R1). No Part Library selector and no lookup step (S7-R2). Inventory Tracking sits below the cost, Sell Price and Core Charge fields and above Tags, with the switch on by default (S4-R1, S4-R2). Min and Max sit under the switch (S4-R4).”
